+/-- The restricted comparison, before scalar extension, in one degree.

+        (((K (O.obj.obj X) (ringFamilySectionIdeal O r f X)).X n).val.obj

+    exact (ModuleCat.semilinearMapAddEquiv ((ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation O).app X).hom _ _)

+    apply LinearMap.ext
+    intro x

+restriction, so they assemble to a morphism of O-module presheaf complexes. The identity
+and composition laws include all identity restrictions. The augmentation equation in hm
+says on pure tensors that its composite with the target augmentation is multiplication
+followed by the extension of p composed with epsilon. Transport hK at A backwards across
+p by ringComplexHasCechModel_of_quasiIso. Apply ringComplex_cech_baseChange_quasiIso to
+this model, hK at O(V), and the extended map; its pure-tensor normalization is precisely
+the augmentation equation just verified. Each evaluated map is a quasi-isomorphism.
+Exactness is objectwise in module presheaves, and module sheafification is exact, so the
+assembled sheaf map is a quasi-isomorphism. By the two adjunctions, the source is exactly
+ringFamilyGlobalExtensionComplex O P. Naturality of adjoint transposition identifies its
+augmentation with ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation O (p composed with epsilon).
+The argument needs no point of the site; on the empty site it is vacuous. An empty list,
+zero or repeated generators, and zero rings use the same ideal-map and tensor formulas. -/
+theorem ringFamilyGlobalExtension_to_family
+    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
+    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
+    [∀ A : CommRingCat.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (RingSiteModules A)]
+    (K : RingComplexFamily.{u}) (ε : RingComplexAugmentations K)
+    (m : RingComplexMaps K) (hm : RingComplexFunctorial K ε m)
+    (hK : ∀ (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (I : {I : Ideal A // I.FG}),
+      RingComplexHasCechModel A I.val (K A I) (ε A I))
+    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
+    (P : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) ℤ)
+    (p : P ⟶ K (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) (ringFamilyGlobalIdeal O r f))
+    (hp : QuasiIso p) (hflat : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients) :
+    QuasiIso (ringFamilyGlobalComparison O K ε m hm r f P p) ∧
+      ringFamilyGlobalComparison O K ε m hm r f P p ≫
+        (ringFamilySheafModel O K ε m hm r f).2 =
+        ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation O
+          (p ≫ ε (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) (ringFamilyGlobalIdeal O r f)) := by sorry
+

+/-! # The localization tensor model after scalar extension from global sections
+
+Source: Stacks Project, algebraization.tex, Tags 0996, 099D(d), 099E.
+(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-cech-model).
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+universe u w wA
+open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
+namespace CategoryTheory
+
+/-- Scalar extension of a K-flat augmented ordered localization model is the tensor Cech
+complex of the corresponding global list. This comparison does not involve a functorial
+family, its transition maps, or the Godement construction.
+
+Source: Stacks Project, algebraization.tex, Tags 0996, 099D(d) and the final paragraph
+of Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-cech-model).
+
+Proof: write A for the global ring and choose the ordered localization complex C supplied
+by hP for the specified list. Its degree-zero module is A; degree q > 0 is the finite sum
+of A localized at the products of q distinct generators, and negative terms vanish.
+The given A-algebra localization arrows are the unique localization maps, so these
+coordinates identify C, its differential and its augmentation with the ordered model.
+The terms are flat and the complex is bounded, hence C is K-flat. Represent the augmented
+derived isomorphism between C and P by a common roof and replace its source by a K-flat
+resolution. Since both targets are K-flat, scalar extension to each O(V) preserves the
+quasi-isomorphisms in this roof. Constant presheaves followed by scalar extension and
+exact sheafification therefore give an augmented derived isomorphism from the scalar
+extension of C to that of P.
+For one generator, the fraction isomorphism O(V) tensor_A A[1/f] to O(V)[1/f(V)] sends
+b tensor (a/f^n) to b*a(V)/f(V)^n; its inverse sends b/f(V)^n to b tensor (1/f^n).
+These formulas commute with restriction, so after sheafification they identify the
+localization terms. Expand the ordered tensor of the r two-term complexes by the subset
+of factors in degree one. Its degree-q summands are indexed by increasing q-subsets.
+The sign for inserting j is (-1) to the number of preceding chosen indices, which is the
+ordered alternating differential. The degree-zero identification is multiplication
+O tensor_A A to O, so the augmentation agrees with ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation.
+Compose the two comparisons. For the empty list both ordered and tensor models are O[0];
+zero or repeated generators and zero section rings obey the same fraction formulas. -/
+theorem ringFamilyGlobalExtension_cech
+    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
+    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
+    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
+      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))]
+    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))]
+    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
+    (P : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) ℤ)
+    (εP : P ⟶ ringComplexSingle (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))
+    (hflat : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
+    (hP : RingComplexHasCechModel (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)
+      (ringFamilyGlobalIdeal O r f).val P εP) :
+    ∃ e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ringedExtendedCech O r f).1 ≅
+        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ringFamilyGlobalExtensionComplex O P),
+      e.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation O εP) =
+        DerivedCategory.Q.map (ringedExtendedCech O r f).2 := by sorry
+
+end CategoryTheory

+module

+/-!
+# Scalar extension from the ring of global sections
+
+Source: Stacks Project, algebraization.tex, Tag 099E, final paragraph.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension).
+
+The functor is the constant module presheaf followed by presheaf scalar extension and
+module sheafification. Its map to the ring sheaf is constructed by the two adjunctions.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public noncomputable section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite AlgebraicGeometry
+
+namespace CategoryTheory
+
+variable {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
+variable (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
+
+/-- The ring of compatible global sections, with pointwise ring operations.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyGlobalRing : CommRingCat.{u} :=
+  let S := RingCat.sectionsSubring (O.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
+  letI : CommRing S := @Subring.toCommRing _ _ S
+  CommRingCat.of S
+
+/-- Evaluation of global sections as a ring-presheaf map.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation :
+    (Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj (RingCat.of (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) ⟶
+      (𝟭 C).op ⋙ ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O).obj where
+  app X := RingCat.ofHom
+    { toFun := fun s ↦ s.val X
+      map_one' := rfl
+      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
+      map_zero' := rfl
+      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
+  naturality _ _ a := by
+    ext s
+    exact (s.property a).symm
+
+/-- The given global list, regarded as elements of the global ring.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyGlobalList (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
+    Fin r → ringFamilyGlobalRing O := f
+
+/-- The finitely generated ideal of the global ring specified by the list.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyGlobalIdeal (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
+    {I : Ideal (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) // I.FG} :=
+  ⟨Ideal.span (Set.range (ringFamilyGlobalList O r f)),
+    Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range _)⟩
+
+/-- Evaluation extends the global generated ideal to the sectionwise generated ideal.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension).
+Proof: ideal map commutes with span, and the image of the global list is its value at X. -/
+theorem ringFamilyGlobalIdeal_map (r : ℕ)
+    (f : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) (X : Cᵒᵖ) :
+    (ringFamilyGlobalIdeal O r f).val.map ((ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation O).app X).hom =
+      (ringFamilySectionIdeal O r f X).val := by
+  rw [ringFamilyGlobalIdeal, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Regard a one-point module as a constant module presheaf on C.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyConstantPresheaf : RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) ⥤
+    PresheafOfModules.{u} ((Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj (RingCat.of (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))) where
+  obj M :=
+    { obj := fun _ ↦ M.val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩)
+      map := fun _ ↦ ModuleCat.ofHom LinearMap.id
+      map_id := by intros; rfl
+      map_comp := by intros; rfl }
+  map a := { app := fun _ ↦ a.val.app (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩) }
+  map_id := by intros; rfl
+  map_comp := by intros; rfl
+
+instance ringFamilyConstantPresheaf_additive : (ringFamilyConstantPresheaf O).Additive where
+  map_add := by intros; rfl
+
+instance ringFamilyGlobalPushforward_additive :
+    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward (ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation O)).Additive where
+  map_add := by intros; rfl
+
+instance ringFamilyGlobalPullback_additive :
+    (PresheafOfModules.pullback (ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation O)).Additive :=
+  (PresheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _).left_adjoint_additive
+
+/-- Extend the constant module presheaf to O and sheafify.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyGlobalExtension : RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) ⥤
+    ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O) :=
+  ringFamilyConstantPresheaf O ⋙
+    PresheafOfModules.pullback (ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation O) ⋙
+      PresheafOfModules.sheafification
+        (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O).obj)
+
+instance ringFamilyGlobalExtension_additive : (ringFamilyGlobalExtension O).Additive := by
+  have : (PresheafOfModules.sheafification
+      (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O).obj)).Additive :=
+    (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction _).left_adjoint_additive
+  unfold ringFamilyGlobalExtension
+  infer_instance
+
+/-- Multiplication O tensor_A A to O, constructed by adjoint transposition of evaluation.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyGlobalExtensionUnit :
+    (ringFamilyGlobalExtension O).obj (ringComplexUnit (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) ⟶
+      SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O) := by
+  let R := ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)
+  let M := SheafOfModules.unit R
+  let S := PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 R.obj)
+  let V := SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙ PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 R.obj)
+  let g : (ringFamilyConstantPresheaf O).obj (ringComplexUnit (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) ⟶
+      (PresheafOfModules.pushforward (ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation O)).obj (V.obj M) :=
+    { app := fun X ↦ ModuleCat.ofHom
+        (X := ((ringFamilyConstantPresheaf O).obj
+          (ringComplexUnit (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))).obj X)
+        (Y := ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward (ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation O)).obj
+          (V.obj M)).obj X)
+        { toFun := fun s ↦ s.val X
+          map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
+          map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
+      naturality := by
+        intro X Y a
+        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
+        apply LinearMap.ext
+        intro s
+        exact (s.property a).symm }
+  exact ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 R.obj)).homEquiv _ _).symm
+    (((PresheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
+      (ringFamilyGlobalEvaluation O)).homEquiv _ _).symm g)
+
+/-- Scalar extension of a complex over the global ring.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyGlobalExtensionComplex
+    (P : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) ℤ) :
+    ringedSiteComplex O :=
+  ((ringFamilyGlobalExtension O).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
+
+/-- Scalar extension of the augmentation, followed by O tensor_A A = O.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 099E.
+(blueprint: def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension). -/
+def ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation
+    {P : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) ℤ}
+    (ε : P ⟶ ringComplexSingle (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) :
+    ringFamilyGlobalExtensionComplex O P ⟶ ringedSiteRingComplex O :=
+  ((ringFamilyGlobalExtension O).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map ε ≫
+    ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (ringFamilyGlobalExtension O)
+      (.up ℤ) 0).app (ringComplexUnit (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))).hom ≫
+    (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map (ringFamilyGlobalExtensionUnit O)
+
+end CategoryTheory
